rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Gateron unveils Magnetic Jade Delta and quiet Oil King switches at TGS 2026 while Wooting 80HE+ preorders continue, keeping hall-effect/rapid-trigger the dominant switch category near its ceiling.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: Reviewers confirm MX2A closes much of the smoothness gap with Gateron stock switches; no new controversy this week, sentiment continues its slow climb out of negative territory.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta
rows.note: Gateron debuts Magnetic Jade Delta (Light/Dark) with triangular stems at TGS 2026, extending the adjustable-actuation Hall Effect lineup's momentum.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: No new catalyst this week; T1 holds steady in tactile-switch buying guides as a Holy Panda alternative, with mentions ticking slightly down.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: Gateron and Keychron's TGS 2026 booths lean further into magnetic-sensing tech, reinforcing TMR/Hall Effect as the industry's shared direction post-Cherry XTRFY K5 Pro TMR launch.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Gateron shows quieted 'Oil King Quiet' variants at TGS 2026 aimed at reducing bottom-out noise, adding fresh buzz to the already-popular linear.

rows.name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
rows.note: Group buy remains deep in its order window with no vendor update this week; estimated February 2027 shipping keeps chatter fading.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: DCS Dolch's October 2026 ship estimate draws nearer, reviving pre-shipping anticipation, while sibling set Molch (group buy closed Aug 23) targets Q1 2027.

rows.name: GMK CYL Red Devils R2
rows.note: GMK CYL Red Devils returns after six years with a Sept 14-Oct 10, 2026 group buy via Omnitype and Keebz N Cables, drawing football-fandom crossover buyers; Q1 2027 ship.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Keychron x GIZMART's Orca echo split-trackball board tops 300 million yen in five days at TGS 2026, a GIZMART crowdfunding record, pushing split/ergo interest to a new ceiling.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: 2026 buying guides now call Alice 'the most popular ergonomic stepping stone of the last five years,' continuing its climb out of negative sentiment.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Community polling cited this week puts 75% layouts at 42% share, the largest of any compact form factor, reinforcing its default status.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Prologue 98% preorders (from $349, Crown Mounting System) continue driving traffic a week after their Sept 17 launch, holding the vendor near its ceiling.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Touchstone's limited-time group buy pricing window closed Sept 27, 2026 (Q1 2027 ETA); post-deadline urgency cools as attention shifts elsewhere.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Vendor touts carbon-neutral shipping and hosts the new DCS SMRT R2 group buy alongside strong customer reviews for fast UK delivery.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Orca echo (with GIZMART) sets a GIZMART crowdfunding record above 300 million yen in five days at TGS 2026, alongside Nape Pro sales and 20+ products on display, holding peak attention.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: TGS 2026 presence and continued MX2A praise keep XTRFY's TMR pivot paying sentiment dividends for an eighth straight week.

rows.name: Wooting
rows.note: 80HE+ preorders progress toward first ABS/Module shipments in late October 2026, with zinc and Lekker Knob Large units following in mid-December.
